description: Test prompts that verify rdk-source-map triggers and produces correct, source-grounded answers about the D-Robotics GitHub org: the hobot- vs hobot_ split, board prefixes (and which are private), the two assembly systems, and which repo to use for a task. Prompts are phrased the way a real RDK developer would (Chinese). Run with-skill vs baseline and grade the assertions.

evals.name: hyphen-vs-underscore-dnn
evals.prompt: D-Robotics 仓库里 hobot-dnn 和 hobot_dnn 有什么区别，我做 ROS2 检测节点该用哪个？
evals.expected_output: Explains hobot-dnn (hyphen) is the BSP/image low-level BPU library and hobot_dnn (underscore) is the ROS2 dnn_node package that wraps it; for a ROS2 node use the underscore one.

assertions.text: Says hobot- (hyphen) is the BSP / system-image low-level library.
Says hobot_ (underscore) is the TROS/ROS2 application package (dnn_node).
Tells the user to use the underscore hobot_dnn for a ROS2 node.

evals.name: s100-bsp-is-private
evals.prompt: 我想从源码构建 RDK S100 的系统镜像，是不是 clone s100-rdk-gen 就行？
evals.expected_output: Notes that s100-rdk-gen / s100-bootloader / s100-hobot-* are private (not anonymously cloneable); public source-build exists only for X3 and X5; suggests official prebuilt image or requesting access.

assertions.text: Says the s100- prefixed BSP/build repos are private / not publicly cloneable.
States that public source-build is available for X3 (rdk-gen) and X5 (x5-rdk-gen).
Does NOT instruct the user to anonymously clone s100-rdk-gen as if it were public.

evals.name: rcl-is-upstream-port
evals.prompt: 组织里的 rcl、rclcpp、rmw_cyclonedds 这些仓库是 RDK 自己开发的算法吗？
evals.expected_output: No — these are upstream ROS2 repos ported/mirrored for the TROS build (pulled by vcstool via ros2.repos), not RDK-original; debug against upstream first.

assertions.text: Says these are upstream ROS2 ports/mirrors, NOT RDK-original algorithms.
Associates them with the TROS workspace build (vcstool / ros2.repos).

evals.name: two-assembly-systems
evals.prompt: RDK 这边构建 OS 镜像和编译 TROS 用的不是一套工具吗？分别用什么？
evals.expected_output: Two systems: OS image uses repo + manifest + *-rdk-gen (pulls hobot- hyphen BSP); TROS uses vcstool + ros2.repos via robot_dev_config (pulls hobot_ underscore packages).

assertions.text: Says OS image build uses repo + manifest + *-rdk-gen.
Says TROS build uses vcstool + ros2.repos (entry robot_dev_config).
Connects the OS build to hobot- (hyphen) repos and the TROS build to hobot_ (underscore) repos.

evals.name: no-s600-prefix
evals.prompt: S600 的 BSP 是不是在 s600-rdk-gen 仓库里？我想找 S600 的板级源码。
evals.expected_output: No s600- prefixed BSP/build repos exist (public or private); S600 support lives only in application-layer repos (e.g. model zoo branches, hobot_* adaptation).

assertions.text: States there is no s600-rdk-gen / s600- prefixed BSP repo.
Says S600 support appears in application-layer repos rather than a dedicated BSP prefix.
